answer_1.quote: We adopted the Big5-Chat dataset , which is a dialogue-based dataset constructed around the Big Five personality framework. It contains 100,000 dialogue examples...
answer_1.outputs: The models generated responses to open-ended questions, self-introductions, and image interpretation prompts.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated instruction-following performance using ALPACAEVAL to ensure that the model's instruction-following capability was preserved.

answer_3.quote: These responses were annotated using the GPT-4o API, which mapped the open-ended outputs to a 5-point Likert scale.
criteria: position on the {trait} dimension of BFI

answer_4.quote: we recruited 10 human raters (8 male, 2 female; average age: 29.1) to independently score a sample of 400 GPT-annotated responses using the same annotation process.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was provided with structured explanations of the Big Five framework and detailed definitions of each trait dimension.
criteria: position on the {trait} dimension of BFI
